name: A Lost Master
summary: In Auberdine, Terenthis prepares to help find Volcor, a night elf lost in Darkshore. He can weave a camouflage cloak to protect the searcher, but needs pelts from the coast's fiercest moonstalkers.

sections.title: A Search into the Wilds
sections.body: Terenthis in Auberdine fears for Volcor and his companion, Grimclaw, as danger closes around the coast of Darkshore. The southern wilds hold aggressive predators and corrupted wildlife. Rather than send an unprotected scout into that danger, Terenthis plans a cloak woven with wild illusions.

sections.title: Pelts of the Pride
sections.body: Ordinary hides cannot confound Darkshore's beasts. Terenthis needs fine pelts from mature moonstalker sires or matriarchs. These great cats roam the woodlands south of Auberdine, near the Wildbend River and toward the forested border of Ashenvale.

sections.title: Delicate Magic
sections.body: Moonstalker fur and nature enchantments let the finished cloak's wearer pass through hostile territory while searching for Volcor. Terenthis warns that the illusion is delicate. Strenuous activity or combat breaks the enchantment and leaves the searcher exposed.

faq.answer: Volcor is a night elf scout or tracker missing in the wilds of southern Darkshore. His companion Grimclaw and Terenthis in Auberdine seek to find him.

aliases: where to get a lost master
faq.answer: Terenthis, a night elf in Auberdine, offers the cloak after adventurers help with earlier local concerns.

faq.q: Where are moonstalker sires and matriarchs found?
faq.answer: Mature moonstalker sires and matriarchs roam southern Darkshore, near the Wildbend River and farther south toward the Ashenvale border.

faq.q: What is the cloak meant to do?
faq.answer: Terenthis means to enchant a cloak to conceal its wearer from Darkshore's hostile beasts, so they can search for Volcor without constantly drawing attacks.

faq.q: Why does Terenthis need specific pelts?
faq.answer: Terenthis needs five fine pelts from moonstalker sires or matriarchs to make the cloak.

faq.q: Does the camouflage cloak have limitations?
faq.answer: Yes. Terenthis warns that the enchantment is fragile. Speaking to others is permitted, but strenuous activity or combat quickly breaks the illusion.

angles.text: As a night elf, finding Volcor reflects your duty to protect your kindred and wild companions across Darkshore.
As a hunter, you can recognize the bond between Volcor and Grimclaw, and the skill needed to track and hunt Darkshore's matriarchs and sires.
As a druid, you can appreciate how Terenthis turns moonstalkers' wild essence into protective camouflage.
